environmentFacts.fact: The locked device was online and the installed original sample remained jp.co.craftegg.band 10.1.4 / 230 / arm64-v8a.
The physical display inventory contains exactly one 720x1600 mode at 60.0 Hz with no alternative refresh rate; peak_refresh_rate and min_refresh_rate settings are absent.
SurfaceFlinger identifies the physical display as 60.00 Hz and the renderer as ARM Mali-G57 MC2, OpenGL ES 3.2 v1.r26p0-01eac0.71c60347ed1612c587f5404db7380c0d.
The production candidate package com.garupa.editor is absent from the locked Android device; prior closure also fixes mainProgramIntegrationAuthorization=false.

Android exposes screenrecord, a SurfaceFlinger compositor and digital framebuffer/video surfaces, but these are upstream of physical panel emission and cannot by themselves measure optical onset or peak.

AudioFlinger and AudioPolicy expose an AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_SPEAKER route and internal PCM/HAL surfaces; these are upstream of amplifier and speaker acoustics and cannot by themselves measure physical speaker output.
The three committed scrcpy H.264 plus FLAC campaigns remain rejected-insufficient-resolution with zero formal behavior coverage and no ROI visible-onset, cue alignment or phase analysis.
This C06 inventory used 23 read-only ADB operations and zero launch, input, Auto Live, Frida, recording, network, installation or settings mutation operations.
